254        }
255
256        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
257            return static::lastNameFemale();
258        }
259        $lastNameRandomElement = static::randomElement(static::$lastNameFormat);
260
261        return $this->generator->parse($lastNameRandomElement);
262    }

294    /**
295     * Generates Nomor Induk Kependudukan (NIK)
296     *
297     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_identification_number#Indonesia
298     *
299     * @param string|null    $gender
300     * @param \DateTime|null $birthDate
301     *
302     * @return string
303     */
304    public function nik($gender = null, $birthDate = null)
305    {
306        // generate first numbers (region data)
307        $nik = $this->birthPlaceCode();
308        $nik .= $this->generator->numerify('##');
309
310        if (!$birthDate) {
311            $birthDate = $this->generator->dateTimeBetween();
312        }
313
314        if (!$gender) {
315            $gender = $this->generator->randomElement([self::GENDER_MALE, self::GENDER_FEMALE]);
316        }
317
318        // if gender is female, add 40 to days
319        if ($gender == self::GENDER_FEMALE) {
320            $nik .= $birthDate->format('d') + 40;
321        } else {
322            $nik .= $birthDate->format('d');
323        }
324
325        $nik .= $birthDate->format('my');
326
327        // add last random digits
328        $nik .= $this->generator->numerify('####');
329
330        return $nik;
331    }
332

338     */
339    protected function birthPlaceCode()
